evidence.excerpt: GENOMFLO addresses the high computational cost and long turnaround time of clinical WGS and WES pipelines at research hospitals in Serbia and the region. The project develops and validates a cloud-cost-aware orchestration layer that dynamically selects between on-premises HPC and spot-instance cloud execution depending on queue state, sample priority, and real-time cloud pricing. It also provides standardised containerised workflow components for alignment and variant calling that can be deployed by laboratories with limited bioinformatics staff. Pilot deployments are planned at two regional clinical partners. The project includes training activities for clinical bioinformaticians and releases all software under an open-source licence.
